whatIs.headingLead: Some of life’s most important lessons
whatIs.para1: Ikigyan is a children’s learning and knowledge platform designed to prepare young minds for the real world. We bring together essential life skills — financial literacy, mental and emotional wellbeing, digital awareness, physical wellness and social awareness — through engaging, age-appropriate learning experiences.
whatIs.para2: Our approach goes beyond traditional academics. Through stories, activities, puzzles, projects and curiosity-led exploration, children learn to Discover → Question → Think → Apply — turning knowledge into understanding, and understanding into everyday life skills.

schoolsHome.heading: Bringing real-world learning into the classroom.
schoolsHome.copy: A structured 26-week programme that complements academic learning with essential life skills. Ikigyan gives teachers ready-to-use learning experiences, activities and resources that help children discover, think and apply knowledge beyond the textbook.
